[[File:LigSword.jpg|thumb|Kaleesh warrior Qymaen jai Sheelal wielding a Lig sword]]

The '''Lig sword''' was a [[weapon]] used by the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] of [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]], named for the [[Lig]] tribe. A product of dedication and [[Artist/Legends|artistry]], a Lig sword took several [[Standard day/Legends|days]] to create. Lig swords began with a pointed tip, and the blade grew wider as it neared the pommel. They were commonly used for [[Mumuu/Legends|mumuu]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]].<ref name="Lord of War">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/86/indexp2.html|text=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War|int=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War}}</ref>

During the [[Huk War]], Lig swords were mass-produced using new techniques and [[Metal/Legends|metals]], such as [[scatrium]] and [[Impervium/Legends|impervium]].<ref name="Lord of War" />
